The separately hosted REST polling adapter handles bounded pagination/current-day backfill, provider market status and health gates.

pull_requests.title: [B10] Run offline CRWV operating economics, funding and valuation
pull_requests.body:
Tracks #86; implements the first executable milestone from #68 / PR #69 at source SHA 29463811e8f77eac9d05b631fcb1c6190bf3f3ff. Reuses #70.

The old research scenario used assumed balances, a uniform borrowing rate and automatic equity funding. This component consumes dated local snapshots and computes 120 monthly periods of cohort billable capacity/contract revenue, fixed/floating/hedged instrument cash flows, restricted cash, explicit funding gaps, earnings/SBC/equity dilution, finite-fleet runoff DCF, forward P/E and reverse valuation. An unfunded fixture produces negative cash with null valuation indications rather than unlimited financing. It preserves valuation records and provides a fixed-horizon revision bridge, lifecycle sensitivities, JSON and readable outputs.

Only research/CRWV/tool/** changes (24 files). No canonical ingestion, shared engines/schemas/workflows, other CRWV research, or runtime changes. Pure finance uses the Python standard library. Historical factor and turnover adapters reuse the pinned #69 calculations/data via local interfaces; no dataset duplication or live-feed claim.

Validation: 39 local unittest tests passed; end-to-end slow/base/bull/unfunded demo executed; pinned factor adapter ran 143 explained sessions per model; dated turnover transformation ran. Published tree 6f17f27ecfd344e4ba602213bfdc8852a8d4184f exactly matches the tested local staged tree. Full commands and captured compact results are under tool/README.md, VALIDATION.md and examples/. Exact-head shared CI passed: https://github.com/whiterosecoffee/_BASKET/actions/runs/40529029687 at 7a33a6f49a2740a93310fa1c66a8090c25dd110a; stores/worker-qc/validate succeeded and job logs confirm SHA. New domain tests were rerun locally at the published head (39 passed), but shared CI does not execute them. Independent domain acceptance is requested in #88.

Limits: all executable finance fixtures are explicitly synthetic, not current CRWV balances or price targets. The primary DCF is finite retained-cash runoff, not perpetual going-concern fair value. Prepayment/refund deferred-revenue accounting, convertibles, detailed lease accounting and full GAAP reconciliation remain unsupported; declared unsupported features fail closed. No calibrated probabilities, verified NVIDIA trade-in guarantee, deployed worker or integrated-main claim. B01 must independently wire domain tests; owner feeds/traversal remain #70. No merge authorized.

pull_requests.title: Build ORCL tracker with valuation, peer comparisons and financing scenarios
pull_requests.body:
ORCL research needs a persistent tracker and an executable bridge from earnings/cash flow to relative value. This implements an append-only evidence ledger, replay/freshness gates, owner-routed refresh work, and a ninth conditional valuation panel.

The valuation engine calculates normalized forward EPS, modeled FCFF/equity FCF, EV-to-equity values, matching-basis weighted peer references, implied prices, reverse EPS/margin requirements, bear/base/bull cases, and incremental financing/dilution effects. A +/-50/100bp grid reprices only declared floating/refinancing/new debt. Negative cash flow remains visible; missing peer weights suppress affected price indications. It never averages unlike raw multiples or invents probabilities.

The publisher reads market/fundamentals/financing revisions from the tracker and appends dependent valuation output. Corrections and expiry hide conditional outputs; synthetic results are visibly labeled and stay in the refresh queue. Demo fixtures contain no actual ORCL prices.

Scope: B00 #75 with bounded B04 engine assignment recorded on #75. New engine subtree engines/valuation/orcl_bridge/** and existing orchestration/ticker_trackers/** only. Long-term engine ownership remains B04. Research work in #83/#84/#85 is untouched; methods coordinated in #80. No merge/release authorized.

Validation: 29 targeted engine/tracker/end-to-end tests and 57 existing orchestration tests pass locally. Source tree published through the GitHub API exactly matches the tested local tree b151de9735a6053f38c9c1fb81954b9b603d2ea6. Tests cover hand-calculated earnings/cash flows/EV, debt repricing/dilution reconciliation, reverse valuation, incomplete peers, mismatched bases/horizons, negative FCF, future/stale/unverified inputs, correction replay, duplicate ingestion and HTML escaping. Missing jsonschema initially prevented broader-suite imports; installed it in the environment and the rerun passed. No repository dependency changes.

Limitations: no production forward-estimate feed or deployed worker; no actual ORCL fair-value claim. NTM forecasts, debt/lease reconciliation and live source adapters remain #76/#61/#62. Financial payload truth is an upstream assertion. Modeling is a simplified annual forward-multiple bridge, not a DCF; share additions apply for the full period, and forecasts must exclude any incremental scenario funding already applied. B01 requested to wire all 29 tests into CI; a passing existing workflow does not prove those new tests ran remotely.

Refs #75, #76, #80.
